description: Phone number + incoming-call icon shown. gate=ADAS fusion master switch(0x4C1) ON, Media_Mobile_State_S(0x43E bit6.5-6.7)=1 active call, Media_Call_Num_S(0x43F bit3.0-8.7) carries the caller number. val_phoneStatus=1 and val_phoneNum are populated together in diAEControl DI_AEC_Get* (lines 1183/1188), diPhoneSurface::Draw shows when phoneStatus in {1,2}.

can.desc: Media_Mobile_State_S = MediaMobileStateS: phone state=1 active call; diDataCenter:471 m_DiPhoneStatus=CycleSignal.MediaMobileStateS -> DiDcGetPhoneStatus, diAEControl val_phoneStatus=1
Media_Call_Num_S: caller phone number digits carried on this bitfield, used to build val_phoneNum (DiDcGetPhoneNumber strings)
